key_insight: CORTEX adds structured, stage-by-stage reasoning traces to 3D chest CT questions so MLLMs can explain and verify their answers, not just predict them.
clinical_relevance: This could make chest CT AI outputs more traceable and easier for radiologists to assess, aligning model reasoning with clinical workflows.
method: Built on CT-RATE chest CT data and expanded it with clinician-aligned reasoning annotations.
Uses a four-stage diagnostic trace: task understanding, visual observation, diagnostic reasoning, and answer synthesis.
Filters traces with rubric-based automated scoring plus expert radiologist review.
evidence_signal: The benchmark includes 76,177 validated reasoning traces across open-ended VQA, closed-ended VQA, and report generation, with stage-level evaluation protocols.
watch_item: Because reasoning traces are generated by large models before expert filtering, performance may depend on annotation quality and may not fully capture real-world clinical complexity.
paper_title: CORTEX: A Structured Reasoning Benchmark for Trustworthy 3D Chest CT MLLMs
